added.title: Senior Deep Learning Engineer
added.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll engage in a collaborative, empowering setting where everyone is encouraged to achieve their fullest potential. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is building a new wave of AI and advanced data technologies for Physical AI. Our MLOps Ground Truth (GT) team develops large-scale data infrastructure, tooling, and AI-based GT generation systems—including Auto-labeling, VLM labeling, and agentic workflows—for automotive and robotics partners worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Deep Learning Engineer to help pioneer the next generation of offline perception foundation models. In this role, you will bridge deep learning research and production, collaborating closely with research teams and human operations and to deliver reliable, scalable, high-quality GT data for autonomous driving and robotics. If you are passionate about solving sophisticated, multimodal AI problems and advancing industry standards, join us.

What You'll Be Doing

Develop and productionize AI-powered auto labeling solutions using deep learning models, vision-language models, and AI agents.
Work in close collaboration with research divisions, know the latest innovative methods, and explore new ideas to advance auto-labeling capabilities.
Translate promising research into scalable production systems, driving iterative improvements through experimentation, thorough evaluation, and error analysis to meet the highest standards for ground truth accuracy and consistency.
Build observability and data quality frameworks covering pipeline health, job execution, labeling quality, data lineage, and GT release readiness.
Optimize distributed processing and GPU inference workloads to improve throughput, resource utilization, cost efficiency, and release turnaround time.
Drive technical decisions and cross-functional execution with research, perception, auto-labeling modeling, data operations, and partner-facing teams to translate requirements into production solutions.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of relevant industry experience developing production models or large-scale machine learning systems.
Required experience in autonomous driving or robotics, with a strong understanding of perception, sensor data, and ground truth quality requirements.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models for perception or auto-labeling, including dataset preparation, experimentation, and performance review.
Strong programming skills in Python, with experience crafting maintainable, well-tested software and fixing complex production systems.
A solid understanding of computer vision, machine learning, multimodal models combining visual and textual data, and AI agent development, including evaluation and production integration.
Experience building reliable data pipelines with data validation, versioning, lineage, and monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex projects, make sound architectural decisions, and deliver measurable improvements in model quality, scalability, reliability, or performance.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with research and engineering teams across global, multidisciplinary organizations.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

A strong research track record, demonstrated through publications or contributions to computer vision, multimodal learning, or autonomous systems.
A proven track record of delivering autonomous driving models or capabilities deployed in production.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying large foundation models, particularly for perception or multimodal applications.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

added.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
added.description:
About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

About The Role

Frontier data for post-training models is expensive to generate and hard to measure. Labs need stronger evidence that the data they receive is accurate, useful to improve models performance, and worth the cost of producing it.

We’re building an Evals platform to measure and improve the quality of expert human data and synthetic data at scale, making Frontier Model training possible and advancing AI capabilities.

We are looking for exceptional Applied AI engineers who enjoy the ownership from problem definition through production delivery. You’ll work closely with researchers and customers, bring rigor to experimentation, and turn promising ideas into reliable products used at scale.

What You'll Do

You will have a rare opportunity to deeply understand how frontier-grade data is generated and evaluated, and build the products and platform to do this at scale so the data we deliver to labs helps models reason more reliably, use tools effectively, and complete complex real-world tasks.

Build a best-in-class evals platform. Work with operators, researchers, and labs to turn ambiguous quality needs into measurable outcomes and reusable products.
Design and deploy production agents. Build agentic workflows for generating, reviewing, investigating, and improving data, with sound tool use, orchestration, human oversight, and failure recovery.
Make quality measurable. Build graders, programmatic verifiers, and reward signals, calibrated against expert judgment, across LLMs, agents, multimodal models, and RL environments.
Own the improvement loop. Develop eval datasets, benchmarks, and agent harnesses; analyze traces, diagnose failure modes, and run experiments until performance moves.
Lead and raise the bar. Own projects from concept through rollout with product, design, operations, and research; set technical direction; mentor engineers and drive technical excellence for the team and the entire engineering org.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard.

A proven product builder. You have substantial experience shipping and operating high-quality software, owning decisions across the stack, and improving products based on how people actually use them.
Deep expertise in agentic workflows and applied AI. You’ve built agents in production and understand tool calling, context management, orchestration, retrieval, human review, and the practical tradeoffs that determine reliability.
Strong engineering fundamentals. You write excellent Python and can build scalable services, APIs, and data pipelines, with disciplined testing, debugging, and system design.
An evaluation-driven approach. You know how to choose meaningful metrics, build representative test sets, assess graders, distinguish real improvements from noise, and iterate until results improve.
Fluency in frontier AI. You understand modern models, agent harnesses, benchmarks, evaluation techniques, and how training data and post-training methods influence model behavior.
Technical judgment and ownership. You’re comfortable designing systems, making tradeoffs, and moving from an unclear problem to a dependable solution in a fast-moving environment.
Collaborative, low-ego communication. You work effectively with engineers, researchers, domain experts, operators, and customers, and make the people around you more effective.

We value demonstrated ability through shipped products, open-source contributions, benchmarks, datasets, or other substantive technical work.

Extra Credit

Research or applied experience in reinforcement learning, alignment, model behavior, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop systems.
Experience developing LLM or agent benchmarks, reward models, evaluation methodologies, annotation systems, or data-quality frameworks.

Why Join Handshake Now

Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

We Offer

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. Benefits for full-time US employees include:

Equity in a fast-growing company
401(k) match, competitive compensation, and financial coaching
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Mental health support and a $500 wellness stipend
Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, and parental coaching
$2,000 annual learning stipend
Flexible PTO, 15 holidays, and 2 flex days
Internet, commuting support, and free lunch and gym access in our San Francisco office
Team outings and referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.

added.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
added.description:
About Beacon AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

What you'll do

At Beacon AI, we're building AI-powered systems that help aviation professionals navigate complex, high-stakes operational decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of agentic AI, information retrieval, and production software engineering. We build systems that reason over diverse sources of information, use tools to investigate problems, and produce reliable, explainable results.

We're looking for engineers who can think critically about how these systems should work, design their underlying information and orchestration architectures, and take them from experimental prototypes to dependable production services.

Design and build agentic systems

Design and implement agent architectures involving tool use, planning, orchestration, state management, and memory.
Develop effective context engineering strategies, balancing relevant information, model capabilities, latency, and cost.
Make thoughtful architectural decisions about when to use autonomous agents, explicit workflows, conventional algorithms, or combinations thereof.
Design tool interfaces and structured model interactions that support reliable, inspectable behavior.

Turn complex information into usable knowledge

Develop an understanding of complex document collections and data sources: their structure, semantics, authority, relationships, and scope.
Translate domain knowledge into effective retrieval systems, structured representations, and agent-accessible tools.
Apply information retrieval, information extraction, and knowledge modeling techniques to heterogeneous structured and unstructured data.
Design strategies for handling temporal relevance, provenance, conflicting evidence, and incomplete information.

Evaluate and improve AI behavior

Develop rigorous evaluations for AI-powered systems, including representative datasets, human annotations, automated assessments, and targeted failure analysis.
Investigate system-level failures across retrieval, context construction, reasoning, tool execution, and final outputs.
Experiment with alternative architectures, models, and prompting strategies, using empirical results to guide decisions.
Help establish engineering practices for measuring and improving the reliability of agentic systems.

Build systems that work in production

Develop reliable services and asynchronous workflows with attention to concurrency, fault tolerance, observability, and maintainability.
Integrate model inference, retrieval systems, and external data services into production applications.
Build and operate containerized workloads and cloud infrastructure.
Collaborate with engineers and domain experts to translate complex operational requirements into working systems.

Areas of specialization

Applied AI is a broad discipline. We don't expect every candidate to have deep expertise in every part of the stack.

We particularly encourage candidates with substantial experience in one or more of the following areas:

Agentic systems and context engineering: Agent orchestration patterns, planning and execution, tool-use architectures, persistent and transient memory, and context management.
Information retrieval and knowledge representation: Semantic and structured retrieval, information extraction, document understanding, entity and relationship modeling, and knowledge-driven tool design.
AI evaluation and reliability: Evaluation methodology, benchmark and dataset construction, human and model-based assessment, statistical analysis, and systematic failure characterization.
Model adaptation and inference optimization: Fine-tuning, model selection, inference serving, quantization, batching, and performance optimization.

We value candidates who bring genuine depth to at least one of these areas, along with the curiosity and engineering judgment to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries.

What will make you successful

Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write maintainable production code, reason about system architecture, and understand testing, debugging, and operational reliability.
Substantive applied AI experience. You've worked on AI systems beyond basic model API integrations and can explain their architecture, tradeoffs, limitations, and observed behavior.
Information modeling instincts. You can understand a new domain, identify its important entities and relationships, and design software abstractions that reflect how its information is actually used.
Experimental discipline. You test assumptions, measure results, investigate failure modes, and use evidence to guide technical decisions.
Independent technical judgment. You can evaluate alternative approaches, recognize unnecessary complexity, and make appropriate tradeoffs.
Clear communication. You can discuss technical decisions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and domain experts.

We care more about demonstrated technical understanding and the quality of your engineering work than familiarity with any particular AI framework.

Our technology environment

Our systems primarily use Python, LangGraph, BAML, AWS Bedrock, PostgreSQL/pgvector, and event-driven AWS infrastructure.

Experience with these technologies is helpful but not required. We're more interested in your understanding of the underlying concepts and ability to work effectively with unfamiliar tools.

Especially valuable experience

Aviation, aerospace, or another technically complex, safety-critical domain.
Computational linguistics, NLP, information science, or knowledge representation.
Designing systems that reason over technical documentation, regulations, or heterogeneous operational data.
Developing or operating distributed, event-driven, and containerized services.
Building AI systems in which traceability, evidence, and human oversight are important.

Examples of problems you might work on

Design an agentic workflow that identifies operational risks from aviation weather, airspace restrictions, aircraft-specific information, and regulatory guidance.
Develop retrieval and tool interfaces that allow agents to navigate multiple information sources while preserving source authority, provenance, and temporal relevance.
Build an evaluation framework that measures the factual completeness, correctness, and operational relevance of AI-generated analyses.
Investigate when an agent should perform additional research, use a specialized tool, or terminate its investigation.
Improve the reliability, latency, and cost of a multi-stage AI workflow through architectural changes informed by evaluation results.

What we're looking for in your application

We'd be particularly interested in hearing about an AI system you've designed or meaningfully improved, including the engineering decisions you made, the alternatives you considered, and how you determined whether the system was successful.

We value thoughtful technical work over the number of frameworks or models listed on a résumé.

Work Location

This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents
Time Off: 3 weeks PTO plus 13+ paid company holidays
401(k): Offered (no current employer match, but we are committed to enhancing this benefit in the future)

Due to U.S. export control regulations, we can only hire U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, Green Card holders, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum or refugee status). We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers. All work must be performed in the United States.

Beacon AI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit harassment or discrimination of any kind in the workplace and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

added.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Engineer

Location:
Atlanta, GA | Austin, TX | Boston, MA | Charlotte, NC | Chicago, IL | Dallas, TX | Houston, TX | Los Angeles, CA | Miami, FL | New York, NY | Ashburn, VA | Phoenix, AZ | Portland, OR | San Francisco Bay Area, CA | Seattle, WA | Remote, US

Your Role

As a Senior AI Engineer on Digital Realty’s AI@Digital team within the Office of the Chief Data Officer, you will design, build, and operate secure, production-grade AI solutions that help teams find information, access governed enterprise data, and make better decisions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI architecture, backend engineering, cloud delivery, and stakeholder partnership. You will build solutions ranging from grounded conversational assistants and retrieval-augmented generation applications to natural-language-to-SQL and tool-using agents. You will also establish the engineering standards and architectural patterns used across the AI platform.

What You’ll Do

Translate complex business needs into secure, scalable AI architectures, including retrieval-augmented generation, natural-language-to-SQL agents, tool-using agents, and conversational assistants.
Build and operate production Python services using technologies such as FastAPI, asynchronous APIs, streaming responses, authentication, rate limiting, typed code, and automated testing.
Design advanced retrieval pipelines using chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, semantic reranking, query decomposition, intent routing, entity resolution, and inline citations.
Connect AI services to governed enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric semantic models, lakehouse and warehouse sources, PostgreSQL, GraphQL services, and master data platforms.
Lead architectural decisions, document technical trade-offs through architecture decision records, and guide solutions through security and architecture reviews.
Oversee the production delivery of enterprise AI capabilities, including the LLM gateway, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, rollback planning, release validation, and platform reconciliation.
Partner with business stakeholders, data owners, Legal, Compliance, Security, and engineering teams to define use cases, data access requirements, delivery scope, risks, and release expectations.
Strengthen application security by addressing identity, network exposure, secrets management, least-privilege access, WAF posture, dependency risks, and cloud-security findings.
Implement observability using OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights to measure performance, latency, cost, reliability, and AI response quality.
Mentor engineers, review code and technical designs, maintain architecture documentation, and establish engineering standards across the AI@Digital platform.

What You’ll Need

Seven or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years building and running LLM or generative AI applications in production.
Advanced Python engineering skills, including asynchronous web services, FastAPI or a similar framework, typed code, automated testing, and production API development.
Hands-on experience designing retrieval-augmented generation solutions using chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, semantic ranking, reranking, and source citations.
Experience building AI agents that call tools, interact with APIs, or generate controlled queries against structured enterprise data.
Production cloud experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure, including containers, managed identities, networking, API management, and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated experience leading technical design, documenting architecture decisions, and presenting solutions through formal architecture or security reviews.
Working knowledge of SQL, enterprise data platforms, data contracts, and integration patterns, with experience partnering with data engineering teams.
Ability to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical deliverables and explain AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs to non-technical leaders.
Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing code and designs, and establishing standards for security, quality, testing, and production readiness.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio, AI governance, OpenTelemetry, application-security testing, or enterprise data center environments would be an advantage.

A Bit About Us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit digitalrealty.com or follow us on LinkedIn and X .

A Bit About Our Team

Technology & Innovation

Our Technology & Innovation team strives to innovate alongside our customers and empower their businesses to thrive. We work closely with our customers to develop insights-based, data-driven technical solutions and differentiated value propositions on PlatformDIGITAL® across the world.

Operating in almost 50 cities globally means we understand how rapidly the world is evolving, so we’ve built a best-in-class development model to qualify, package and enable cloud-to-core-to-edge hybrid IT solutions. Our deep technical heritage, combined with our global footprint, means the Technology & Innovation team can create and deploy services and solutions that are at the heart of the digital economy.

What We Can Offer You

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team that works together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll work with colleagues across different business areas, challenge the way we do things, and put your ideas into action. We’ll also provide development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals; they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners, and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s overall goals and values.

Our published pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new-hire pay for the full-time position, determined by role, level, and geographical location. Individual pay is based on additional factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. An employee’s total compensation package varies by role and may include salary, cash bonus or commissions, and equity awards not quantified below.

Compensation range: $160,000–$190,000 annually.
This compensation range represents the company’s good-faith belief as to what it will pay as a base salary for this position at the time of posting.

Benefits:
For this role, benefits include medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) match, disability benefits, wellness and education benefits, an employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, holidays, and more.

added.description:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

Join Lam as a Product Engineer with expertise in Data Science and Advanced Analytics, where you'll combine hands-on semiconductor experimentation with modern analytical methods to solve complex process and hardware challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with process development, technology development, product engineering, and customer escalations. You will design and execute experiments, develop advanced test vehicles, analyze data from multiple sources, and apply statistical and machine learning techniques to identify root causes, optimize processes, and uncover underlying physical mechanisms.

Operating at the intersection of semiconductor engineering, experimental science, and data analytics, you will transform laboratory and field data into actionable insights that improve product performance, accelerate technology development, and support data-driven engineering decisions.

What You’ll Do

This position is for a Product Engineer with Data Science specialization within the Selective Etch Product Group, part of the Global Products Group, based in Fremont, CA.

Process Development & Engineering

Perform process engineering research, development, characterization, and evaluation in support of Lam's semiconductor capital equipment and systems.
Support new technology development, product qualification, and customer deployment activities.
Design, execute, and analyze experiments to investigate process, hardware, and system-level performance.
Develop advanced test vehicles and apply systematic problem-solving methodologies to improve product capability and reliability.
Compile and evaluate experimental data to establish process understanding and engineering recommendations.

Customer Escalations & Root Cause Analysis

Lead technical investigations associated with customer escalations by combining engineering fundamentals, experimental observations, and advanced analytics.
Apply statistical analysis, engineering judgment, and structured root-cause methodologies to identify failure mechanisms and drive corrective actions.
Partner with cross-functional teams to rapidly resolve product and process issues impacting customer performance.

Data Science, AI & Advanced Analytics

Develop predictive models and data-driven methodologies that improve understanding of process behavior and equipment performance.
Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics techniques to laboratory, manufacturing, and field data sets.
Develop analytics tools, automated workflows, and visualization methods that enable engineers to efficiently analyze complex datasets.
Utilize data science methodologies to optimize experiments, improve process windows, accelerate root cause analysis, and support technology development.

Collaboration & Communication

Collaborate closely with process engineers, hardware engineers, systems engineers, field organizations, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.
Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, management, and customer stakeholders.
Contribute to building a culture of scientific rigor and data-driven decision making across the organization.

Who We’re Looking For

PhD or Master's degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering Physics, or a related engineering or scientific discipline.
Demonstrated expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Statistics, Scientific Computing, or Advanced Analytics.
Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, experimental methods, and quantitative analysis.
Experience designing, executing, and interpreting laboratory, research, or engineering experiments.
Proven ability to apply statistical methods, machine learning, or AI techniques to scientific or engineering problems.
Programming experience with Python and commonly used scientific computing, machine learning, and data analytics libraries.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to audiences with varied levels of expertise.
Passion for solving real-world engineering challenges through a combination of experimentation, data analysis, and scientific reasoning.

Candidates with advanced degrees in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative disciplines may also be considered if they have demonstrated experience applying data science techniques to experimental, scientific, manufacturing, semiconductor, or engineering problems.

Preferred Qualifications

Semiconductor process, equipment, product engineering, or technology development experience.
Experience with semiconductor plasma, etch, deposition, surface science, or related applications.
Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques to physical systems, manufacturing processes, or scientific data.
Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), multivariate statistics, regression analysis, and predictive modeling.
Experience developing predictive models, anomaly detection algorithms, or engineering analytics tools.
Laboratory experience involving physics, chemistry, materials characterization, or semiconductor process development.
Experience translating experimental observations into predictive models and actionable engineering recommendations.
Familiarity with root cause analysis methodologies and failure analysis techniques.
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously.
Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and matrixed environments.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

added.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Enabled Production Tools
added.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build tools, pipelines, and AI-enabled systems for complex creative production workflows. You will connect AI models with DCC applications, APIs, internal services, and production infrastructure to support artists, technical artists, designers, and engineers.

A central part of the role is building reliable, multi-step agentic workflows that coordinate tools, maintain state, and recover from failures. You will combine hands-on development with technical leadership to deliver production-quality software, usable artist-facing tools, and maintainable content pipelines.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own tools and pipeline systems from workflow discovery and architecture through implementation, rollout, maintenance, and production support!
Build agentic workflows that coordinate models, tools, APIs, and services, with context management, state tracking, validation, retries, and failure recovery.
Develop AI-enabled engineering tools for coding, testing, debugging, codebase analysis, code review, and workflow automation.
Create DCC integrations, plugins, panels, desktop applications, and services that address the needs of artists and technical artists.
Build and maintain content pipelines covering authoring, validation, publishing, versioning, asset management, and delivery to rendering or real-time systems.
Design software architecture, APIs, and data contracts that support maintainability, performance, and integration across production systems.
Establish automated testing, agent evaluations, tracing, monitoring, and appropriate access controls to ensure reliable and observable operation.
Manage packaging, dependencies, compatibility, and releases across supported applications and production environments.
Partner with users to prioritize improvements, lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and document systems to support adoption and ongoing maintenance.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience!
8+ years of relevant software engineering experience developing production tools, content pipelines, or comparable workflow systems.
2+ years of technical leadership experience, including leading engineering projects, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and coordinating delivery.
Strong Python skills and experience with software architecture, API design, automated testing, debugging, and maintainable code.
Background with integrating with DCC applications and supporting content workflows from authoring through validation, publishing, and downstream delivery.
Experience building multi-step AI workflows that invoke tools or APIs and interact with existing software systems, including state management, evaluation, and failure handling.

About The Company

At AstroForge, our mission is to make space resources accessible on Earth. We mine asteroids to extract valuable minerals in space at a lower cost and smaller carbon footprint than current terrestrial mining methods. Along the way, we seek to leverage the technologies we build to provide additional value across other domains. We offer a unique opportunity to join an exciting team looking to expand humanity's capabilities in space.

Job Description

AstroForge is building Solo, an autonomy platform that allows spacecraft to operate millions of miles from Earth without waiting on ground control. As a Data Scientist, you will turn hardware test and simulation data into insights and models that help us understand spacecraft behavior, detect anomalies, and support on-board decision-making that responds to unexpected conditions. You will work with a small team on an early-stage effort where your decisions shape how the whole system is built, determining what the data can reliably tell us and evaluating how well our models perform.

We value first-principles thinking and strong mathematical foundations over experience with any particular tool or industry. Aerospace experience is not required, and we welcome applicants from other fields.

Responsibilities

Analyze data from propulsion, power, navigation, and other spacecraft systems to understand behavior and relationships.
Define approaches for data normalization, feature development, and validation that preserve physical meaning and account for uncertainty.
Develop baseline and candidate statistical, mathematical, or machine learning models for system state estimation, anomaly detection, and prediction in partnership with ML Scientists, who own model architecture.
Establish evaluation metrics and baselines, test models across operating conditions, and communicate their limitations.
Partner with Data Engineers to define dataset structure, quality requirements, and reproducible analysis workflows.
Work with hardware and flight software teams to connect data and models to the physical systems they describe, including what can run on board.
Own open-ended analytical problems and help shape the technical direction of our data and modeling work.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree or higher in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, data science, computer science, or a related technical field.
Experience in data science, statistical modeling, or scientific computing through professional work, research, or substantial technical projects.
Proficiency in Python or a similar language for numerical analysis and modeling.
Strong mathematical and statistical foundations, with the ability to apply quantitative reasoning to physical systems.
Experience analyzing complex datasets and the ability to work independently and communicate clearly with a multidisciplinary team.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience with time-series analysis, signal processing, or multivariate sensor data.
Experience with model evaluation, uncertainty estimation, or validation using real-world data.
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling on complex real-world data.
Experience in aerospace, robotics, energy, manufacturing, or another field involving physical systems.
PhD in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

added.description:
Sanas is pioneering the future of human communication. Founded by a team of Stanford researchers and entrepreneurs with deep industry experience, Sanas has developed the world's first real-time speech AI platform capable of accent translation, noise cancellation, speech enhancement, cross-language communication, and more.

Sanas makes conversations clearer, more inclusive, and more effective, removing barriers that prevent people from being understood, regardless of accent, background noise, or native language.

Sanas is currently one of the fastest growing startups in Silicon Valley, growing from $16M to $50M ARR in 2025. The company's core business is profitable and is on track to end 2026 with >$77M ARR. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering with a design-minded product engineering culture to build and ship cutting-edge AI models and experiences — entirely in-house.

Sanas is a 130 person team, established in 2020. In this short span, we've successfully secured over $100 million in funding. Our innovation has been supported by the industry's leading investors, including Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Quadrille Capital, General Catalyst, Quiet Capital, and other influential investors. Our reputation is further solidified by collaborations with numerous Fortune 100 companies. With Sanas, you're not just adopting a product; you're investing in the future of communication.

If you’re looking to have a significant role in roadmapping and driving technical directions, if you’re looking to deploy challenging and big ideas without much overhead or slowness, if you're looking to leave your mark on an ambitious, generational mission to change how the worlds thinks about speech + AI, then Sanas is a well-suited place for you.

The role

You are the go-to software engineer our customers talk to when the model has to actually work in their environment and operations. You join their calls, figure out what's really broken, and ship the fix — integration code, deployment config, or a patch to our platform.

Most of the work starts with Language Translation: real-time speech-to-speech translation running on customer infrastructure. Increasingly it's Sovereign AI — Sanas AI models and solutions deployed inside a customer's own AWS account or private data center, with no data leaving their walls.

You’ll work side by side with our most important customers on the deployments that matter most. One week you’re sketching system architecture and shaping product direction, the next you’re shipping a production integration. The problems are hard and they’re yours to own end to end, from first call to live traffic.

What You'll Do

Join customer calls with sales, solutions, and leadership. Diagnose technical issues live and own them through to resolution.
Build and debug integrations between Sanas and customer systems: telephony stacks (SIP, WebRTC, media servers), contact center platforms, mobile and desktop clients, and our APIs and SDKs.
Deploy Sanas models on customer infrastructure: their AWS, GCP or Azure accounts, Kubernetes clusters, air-gapped environments, and private data centers.
Size and tune inference for real-time workloads — GPU and CPU footprints, latency budgets, concurrency, throughput, and cost per session.
Profile and fix production problems across the stack: audio quality, latency spikes, model behavior, networking, scaling.
Write the code that turns one-off customer fixes into reusable platform features, tooling, and deployment templates.
Bring structured findings back to ML research, inference, and platform teams: what broke, why, and what we should build.
Produce clear runbooks, reference architectures, and integration guides so the next deployment is faster than the last.

What We're Looking For

A very strong software engineer first. 2+ years shipping production systems, with deep fluency in Python and at least one of Go, C++, or Rust.
Solid grasp of ML fundamentals: how models are trained, evaluated, and served, and why they fail in the real world.
Hands-on experience with model inference in production — serving frameworks (Triton, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, vLLM or similar), batching, quantization, GPU utilization.
Strong cloud and infrastructure skills: AWS in depth, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or equivalent IaC, networking and security basics.
Comfort deploying into environments you don't control — restricted networks, customer security reviews, limited access, on-prem hardware.
Excellent debugging instincts across distributed, latency-sensitive systems.
Clear communicator with customers and executives alike. You can explain a latency regression to a CTO and to a junior engineer.
High ownership. You treat a customer's problem as yours until it's solved.

Nice to have

Speech and audio experience: ASR, TTS, machine translation, real-time audio pipelines, codecs.
Prior forward deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering role at an infrastructure or AI company.
Telecom or contact center integrations — SIP trunks, carrier networks, CCaaS platforms.
Sovereign or regulated deployments: air-gapped installs, data residency, healthcare or government compliance.
Experience with GPU cluster operations, NVIDIA tooling, or CPU-optimized inference.
Startup experience, comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of writing things down.

added.title: Solutions Architect, SMB
added.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Stripe’s SMB Solutions Architecture (SA) team works with technical and business leaders (CTO/ CIO/ CEO/ Founders etc.), payments leaders and product engineering teams in the mid-market segment to evangelize Stripe’s solutions in the market. A solutions architect’s role is to build relationships with decision makers and think strategically about the business needs of Stripe’s customers. Solution Architects identify and propose Stripe solutions to solve complex business challenges and drive growth for our customers. SAs establish and prescribe best practices around a customer’s strategy, provide business and technical thought leadership and are viewed as a trusted advisor. They work on scaling business processes aligned to maximizing account coverage while working closely with customer and partner resources to deliver a solution that can be adopted quickly.

What you’ll do

As a member of the team, the Solutions Architect will build highly consultative trusted relationships with c-level executives and technical decision makers in the customer’s organization to provide business and technical thought leadership, and become a trusted advisor in solving mission-critical business challenges. She/he will architect business models with them so they can drive new monetization opportunities and growth for both the user and Stripe.

Responsibilities

Drive thought leadership and build executive relationships with key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO & Head of Payments. Strive to become their trusted advisor.
Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives and apply Stripe’s payments, SaaS, Banking-as-a-Service and Link Network solutions to customer challenges
Secure the technical win for Stripe’s products by delivering demos, responding to RFPs, evangelizing Stripe’s products, and collaborating internally on narratives that align with the customer’s goals.
Emphasis on creating scalable processes (1:M customer engagements, Webinars, office hours etc), partnerships (with external and internal partners) and scaled assets (reusable videos/ templates, playbooks) in order to act as a force-multiplier in the sales process.
Expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts to new global markets and business units by introducing new capabilities and local payment methods
Collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders including go-to-market, product and marketing to deliver impactful EBC briefings for SMB accounts
Act as the voice of the customer to inform our product team on insights, trends, and opportunities across our SMB accounts.
Work closely with professional services and partners to accelerate activations and time to live
Collaborate with partners to help Stripe scale and reach its Total Addressable Market
Approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way with users and collaborate internally

Who you are

An ideal candidate should have experience working for medium to large software companies (preferably in In payment-tech), focused on identifying business priorities, technology strategy, and solution design. They will have demonstrated the ability to become a trusted advisor to senior executives and facilitate customer success including business value identification(discovery/ demo cycles), road mapping, as well as advising and defining successful execution strategies.

Ideal candidates have external customer-facing experience, have payment expertise (preferred but not required) who can present and architect Stripe’s solutions, and persuade decision makers to leverage Stripe technology to drive business value. Candidates have previous experience in web architecture, enterprise architecture or experience defining and optimizing financial business processes.

Minimum Requirements

2+ years of experience in a similar customer-facing engineering role (e.g. solutions architect, sales engineer, customer success, professional services delivery) for a fin-tech/payment-tech / global software enterprise or 3+ years of total relevant experience (software development, enterprise sales/ architecture, business development etc.)
Presenting and architecting solutions
Deep understanding or background in writing code in at least 2 of Stripe’s primary deployment languages (Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, etc.)
Outstanding oral and written communication skills, presentation skills, and comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Able and willing to learn Stripe solutions (Payments, Billing, Connect, etc.)
Ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact with each other (ERP, CRM, Billing, Tax, Legacy)
Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
Strong organizational/time management skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities while working with multiple opportunities and customers.
Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with the broader GTM team to support our users.
Experience solving open ended business problems with a combination of technology and creative thinking
Ability to travel per business needs

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $156,700 - $235,100. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

added.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Systems - Moveworks
added.description:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering
role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

What You Get To Do In This Role

Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required

0-2+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Responsibilities

About the Team:
The Emerging Product Engineering Team is the incubator for TikTok USDS JV's newest ventures in the US market. We are responsible for the end-to-end success of a diverse portfolio applications. We operate with a strong “0→1” mindset, prioritizing agility, rapid iteration, and creative problem-solving to build and scale products.

We are now looking for a Data Scientist who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is passionate about building new businesses from the ground up. In this role, you will define measurement frameworks, unlock user insights, and build data-driven foundations that enable our emerging products to launch, localize, and scale successfully in the U.S. Market.

Responsibilities:
- Define 0→1 Metrics: Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and growth teams to establish core KPIs, product health metrics, and foundational tracking for early-stage products.
- Unlock User Insights: Analyze early user behavior, engagement funnels, and retention patterns to deliver actionable insights that directly influence product roadmaps and successful U.S. market entry.
- Experimentation & Iteration: Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests or quasi-experiments to validate new features, localization efforts, and growth strategies under rapid iteration cycles.

- BS / MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, or related field).
- 3+ years of data science or product analytics experience, delivering hands-on insights for consumer-facing production applications.
- Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language used for data analysis (e.g., Python or R).
- Solid understanding of statistical concepts, experimental design (A/B testing), and core product metrics (retention, conversion, engagement).

- Experience working in an incubator, startup, or "0 to 1" product environment.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

added.title: Senior Deep Learning Engineer
added.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll engage in a collaborative, empowering setting where everyone is encouraged to achieve their fullest potential. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is building a new wave of AI and advanced data technologies for Physical AI. Our MLOps Ground Truth (GT) team develops large-scale data infrastructure, tooling, and AI-based GT generation systems—including Auto-labeling, VLM labeling, and agentic workflows—for automotive and robotics partners worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Deep Learning Engineer to help pioneer the next generation of offline perception foundation models. In this role, you will bridge deep learning research and production, collaborating closely with research teams and human operations and to deliver reliable, scalable, high-quality GT data for autonomous driving and robotics. If you are passionate about solving sophisticated, multimodal AI problems and advancing industry standards, join us.

What You'll Be Doing

Develop and productionize AI-powered auto labeling solutions using deep learning models, vision-language models, and AI agents.
Work in close collaboration with research divisions, know the latest innovative methods, and explore new ideas to advance auto-labeling capabilities.
Translate promising research into scalable production systems, driving iterative improvements through experimentation, thorough evaluation, and error analysis to meet the highest standards for ground truth accuracy and consistency.
Build observability and data quality frameworks covering pipeline health, job execution, labeling quality, data lineage, and GT release readiness.
Optimize distributed processing and GPU inference workloads to improve throughput, resource utilization, cost efficiency, and release turnaround time.
Drive technical decisions and cross-functional execution with research, perception, auto-labeling modeling, data operations, and partner-facing teams to translate requirements into production solutions.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of relevant industry experience developing production models or large-scale machine learning systems.
Required experience in autonomous driving or robotics, with a strong understanding of perception, sensor data, and ground truth quality requirements.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models for perception or auto-labeling, including dataset preparation, experimentation, and performance review.
Strong programming skills in Python, with experience crafting maintainable, well-tested software and fixing complex production systems.
A solid understanding of computer vision, machine learning, multimodal models combining visual and textual data, and AI agent development, including evaluation and production integration.
Experience building reliable data pipelines with data validation, versioning, lineage, and monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex projects, make sound architectural decisions, and deliver measurable improvements in model quality, scalability, reliability, or performance.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with research and engineering teams across global, multidisciplinary organizations.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

A strong research track record, demonstrated through publications or contributions to computer vision, multimodal learning, or autonomous systems.
A proven track record of delivering autonomous driving models or capabilities deployed in production.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying large foundation models, particularly for perception or multimodal applications.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 21, 2026.

added.description:
Aimpoint Digital is a market-leading data, AI, analytics, and operations research advisory and solution engineering firm. We help organizations design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade data and AI platforms, decision intelligence solutions, optimization systems, and production AI applications.

We are not a commodity consulting firm. We are a technical partner to organizations that need to move beyond experimentation and deploy AI into real business workflows with the architecture, governance, reliability, and engineering discipline required for production.

We believe successful AI initiatives require much more than prompting an LLM. They require strong software engineering, scalable architecture, reliable deployment, thoughtful evaluation, and disciplined engineering practices.

About The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will work directly with clients to design, build, deploy, and scale enterprise AI solutions. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI technologies to deliver production-ready systems that create measurable business value.

You will work across the entire AI engineering lifecycle; from solution architecture and application development to deployment, evaluation, and operationalization.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and deploy production AI applications, copilots, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows
Translate business problems into scalable technical solutions using modern AI engineering best practices
Develop backend services, APIs, and application architectures that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems
Build multi-agent systems, AI agents, workflow automation, and decision-support systems
Deploy AI solutions into production with appropriate security, observability, monitoring, evaluation, and governance
Design AI systems that integrate with enterprise data platforms, APIs, databases, messaging systems, and business applications
Collaborate with cross-functional client teams including engineering, data, product, architecture, security, and business stakeholders
Experience deploying and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes, including scaling, service networking, resource management, and production monitoring
Contribute reusable accelerators, frameworks, technical assets, and thought leadership that strengthen the AI Engineering practice
Stay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend practical approaches that improve client outcomes

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems and building production software. You are comfortable moving between software engineering, AI application development, cloud architecture, and client collaboration.

You understand that successful AI systems require excellent engineering, not just excellent models.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of professional software engineering experience building production applications
1+ years designing and deploying AI or machine learning solutions into production
Strong programming experience using Python, Java, C#, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages
Experience building scalable backend systems, APIs, or distributed applications.
Experience developing AI applications using modern LLMs, machine learning models, or intelligent automation solutions
Experience with online and offline evaluation, observability, context engineering, guardrails, and AI governance
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, or production deployment pipelines
Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including testing, version control, CI/CD, code reviews, and system design
Experience using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or other comparable coding harnesses
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies
Experience deploying applications using containers, Kubernetes, serverless platforms, or similar cloud-native technologies
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to independently own technical workstreams while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

Preferred Qualifications

One or more of the following is a plus:

Experience developing production APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot, .NET, and Express
Experience building multi-agent systems, AI automated workflows, agents, semantic search, vector databases, or knowledge graph retrieval applications
Experience designing distributed systems, concurrency, or high-scale cloud applications
Experience deploying AI solutions serving 1000+ users
Consulting experience or experience working directly with enterprise customers
Experience building data pipelines, including ETL, ELT, batch, and streaming pipelines for analytics and AI applications
Experience pre-training or fine-tuning LLMs

added.title: Founding AI Engineer
added.description:
About Skiffra

Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision-making in physical industries.

We're developing AI-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real.

Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions.

As a Founding AI Engineer, you will be the architect of our core intelligence. This is a role for a high-leverage builder who can move fluidly between prompt engineering, backend systems, and model optimization. You will design the "brain" of Skiffra, moving agentic workflows from whiteboards to production-grade systems that handle real enterprise data at scale. This is a founding-level role for builders who value shipping over dogma and real-world impact over demos.

This is a full-time role in our Los Angeles office.

What You'll Do

Architect & Build Agentic Systems: Design, prototype, and harden production-grade orchestration frameworks that leverage LLMs, persistent memory, and tool-integration to navigate complex, non-linear enterprise tasks
Build the Data Flywheel: Implement sophisticated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, ensuring high-fidelity context retrieval from fragmented data sources
Evaluate & Iterate: Build internal benchmarking and evaluation suites to measure and improve model reliability, grounding, and latency
Strategic Modeling: Architect high-performance intelligence stacks by making pragmatic trade-offs between Frontier Reasoning Models for long-horizon agentic planning, Fine-tuned Open-Weight Models for data sovereignty and low-latency inference, and Deterministic Heuristics for reliable, cost-efficient guardrails
Cross-Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to turn ambiguity into working software

What We're Looking For

Systems Engineering: 7+ years of experience and a deep background in building production software. You understand that "AI" is only as good as the infrastructure surrounding it
Modern AI Fluency: Deep practical experience with the transformer-based stack: embeddings, vector databases, tool-calling, and context window management
Production LLM Experience: 2+ years shipping LLM-based products to real users in production
Python Power-User: You are comfortable building entire systems, not just experimenting in notebooks
Reliability Mindset: You have strong instincts for failure modes (hallucinations, API timeouts, "infinite loops" in agents) and how to build guardrails against them
Security Mindset: You treat access to enterprise data as part of the design, not an afterthought
Clear communicator with founder-level ownership mindset

Nice to Have

Experience in building complex, multi-step workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex or PydanticAI
Hands-on experience with Fine-tuning and PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) to adapt open-weight models for domain-specific tasks
Experience with human-in-the-loop workflows and enterprise identity (SSO, role-based access)
A background in Enterprise Operations (Industrial, Logistics, Fintech, or CRM workflows).
Strong opinions on where AI creates value and where it's just expensive noise

How We Work

We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly.

Location & Work Model

This is a hybrid role requiring regular in-person collaboration at the designated office location, as specified in the job posting (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Montreal, or Brisbane). We are not a fully remote company.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Benefits & Eligibility

This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs.

Equal Opportunity

Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
