Job Description

Senior AI Engineer

Location:
Atlanta, GA | Austin, TX | Boston, MA | Charlotte, NC | Chicago, IL | Dallas, TX | Houston, TX | Los Angeles, CA | Miami, FL | New York, NY | Ashburn, VA | Phoenix, AZ | Portland, OR | San Francisco Bay Area, CA | Seattle, WA | Remote, US

Your Role

As a Senior AI Engineer on Digital Realty’s AI@Digital team within the Office of the Chief Data Officer, you will design, build, and operate secure, production-grade AI solutions that help teams find information, access governed enterprise data, and make better decisions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI architecture, backend engineering, cloud delivery, and stakeholder partnership. You will build solutions ranging from grounded conversational assistants and retrieval-augmented generation applications to natural-language-to-SQL and tool-using agents. You will also establish the engineering standards and architectural patterns used across the AI platform.

What You’ll Do

Translate complex business needs into secure, scalable AI architectures, including retrieval-augmented generation, natural-language-to-SQL agents, tool-using agents, and conversational assistants.
Build and operate production Python services using technologies such as FastAPI, asynchronous APIs, streaming responses, authentication, rate limiting, typed code, and automated testing.
Design advanced retrieval pipelines using chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, semantic reranking, query decomposition, intent routing, entity resolution, and inline citations.
Connect AI services to governed enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric semantic models, lakehouse and warehouse sources, PostgreSQL, GraphQL services, and master data platforms.
Lead architectural decisions, document technical trade-offs through architecture decision records, and guide solutions through security and architecture reviews.
Oversee the production delivery of enterprise AI capabilities, including the LLM gateway, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, rollback planning, release validation, and platform reconciliation.
Partner with business stakeholders, data owners, Legal, Compliance, Security, and engineering teams to define use cases, data access requirements, delivery scope, risks, and release expectations.
Strengthen application security by addressing identity, network exposure, secrets management, least-privilege access, WAF posture, dependency risks, and cloud-security findings.
Implement observability using OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights to measure performance, latency, cost, reliability, and AI response quality.
Mentor engineers, review code and technical designs, maintain architecture documentation, and establish engineering standards across the AI@Digital platform.

What You’ll Need

Seven or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years building and running LLM or generative AI applications in production.
Advanced Python engineering skills, including asynchronous web services, FastAPI or a similar framework, typed code, automated testing, and production API development.
Hands-on experience designing retrieval-augmented generation solutions using chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, semantic ranking, reranking, and source citations.
Experience building AI agents that call tools, interact with APIs, or generate controlled queries against structured enterprise data.
Production cloud experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure, including containers, managed identities, networking, API management, and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated experience leading technical design, documenting architecture decisions, and presenting solutions through formal architecture or security reviews.
Working knowledge of SQL, enterprise data platforms, data contracts, and integration patterns, with experience partnering with data engineering teams.
Ability to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical deliverables and explain AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs to non-technical leaders.
Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing code and designs, and establishing standards for security, quality, testing, and production readiness.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio, AI governance, OpenTelemetry, application-security testing, or enterprise data center environments would be an advantage.

A Bit About Us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit digitalrealty.com or follow us on LinkedIn and X .

A Bit About Our Team

Technology & Innovation

Our Technology & Innovation team strives to innovate alongside our customers and empower their businesses to thrive. We work closely with our customers to develop insights-based, data-driven technical solutions and differentiated value propositions on PlatformDIGITAL® across the world.

Operating in almost 50 cities globally means we understand how rapidly the world is evolving, so we’ve built a best-in-class development model to qualify, package and enable cloud-to-core-to-edge hybrid IT solutions. Our deep technical heritage, combined with our global footprint, means the Technology & Innovation team can create and deploy services and solutions that are at the heart of the digital economy.

What We Can Offer You

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team that works together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll work with colleagues across different business areas, challenge the way we do things, and put your ideas into action. We’ll also provide development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals; they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners, and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s overall goals and values.

Our published pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new-hire pay for the full-time position, determined by role, level, and geographical location. Individual pay is based on additional factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. An employee’s total compensation package varies by role and may include salary, cash bonus or commissions, and equity awards not quantified below.

Compensation range: $160,000–$190,000 annually.

added.title: Semantic AI Engineer
added.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Semantic AI Engineer to build the knowledge foundation that our enterprise AI agents depend on. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on how agents remember, reason over, and share what the company knows. You will design and build a corporate knowledge graph that agents both draw from and contribute to, along with the agentic memory systems that let agents keep context across tasks, users, and time. You have a proven track record of modeling complex business domains, building production knowledge graphs or semantic layers, and connecting them to LLM-based applications.

This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI.

Your Responsibilities

Design, build, and evolve a knowledge graph that represents Rockwell's people, products, customers, processes, systems, and data, and serves as shared context for AI agents across functions.
Design write-back patterns that let agents contribute new facts, relationships, and learnings to the knowledge graph safely, with provenance, confidence, validation, and human review where needed.
Architect agentic memory for our agent platform, including short-term (working) memory, long-term episodic and semantic memory, and shared organizational memory, with clear policies for retention, summarization, and forgetting.
Develop ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic models with business and data owners, and keep business definitions consistent across analytics, BI, and AI tools.
Build ingestion and extraction pipelines that turn structured and unstructured enterprise content (documents, tickets, ERP and CRM records, engineering data) into graph entities and relationships using LLM-assisted entity and relation extraction.
Implement GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph traversal combined with vector and keyword search) to ground agent responses and reduce hallucinations.
Expose the knowledge graph and memory services to agents through standard interfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and APIs.
Establish governance for the knowledge graph, including access control, data lineage, quality checks, freshness, and alignment with enterprise data governance and security policies.
Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to prioritize knowledge domains and measure the impact on agent accuracy and usefulness.

Key Technical Skill Expectations

Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Modeling:
Design ontologies and graph schemas using property graph (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin) and/or RDF/OWL approaches, with query languages such as Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL. Apply entity resolution, schema alignment, and graph data quality techniques.

Agentic Memory:
Architect memory layers for AI agents, including working memory, episodic and semantic long-term memory, memory consolidation and retrieval, and shared memory across multi-agent systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Hindsight, LLMWiki etc.

Corporate Knowledge Graph for Agents:
Build a living, agent-writable knowledge graph with provenance, trust levels, versioning, and conflict resolution so that knowledge produced by agents can be reviewed, trusted, and reused across the enterprise.

GraphRAG & Retrieval:
Implement retrieval pipelines that combine knowledge graph traversal with vector search (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Redis) and embeddings to deliver accurate, explainable context to LLMs.

Semantic Layer & Open Standards:
Understand semantic layers and metric definitions, and how open standards keep business meaning consistent as it moves between AI agents, BI platforms, and data tools.

Agent Integration & Security:
Expose knowledge and memory services through MCP servers and APIs, with fine-grained access control, PII handling, and audit logging that comply with enterprise governance and security policies.

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related field.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or search and retrieval systems.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a similar discipline.
Hands-on experience building and operating a production knowledge graph in an enterprise setting.
Experience designing memory for LLM agents and multi-agent systems in production.
Familiarity with Apache Ossie (incubating, formerly Open Semantic Interchange), the vendor-neutral standard for exchanging semantic models and metric definitions across AI, BI, and analytics tools.
Familiarity with the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), the open specification for representing agent- and human-readable knowledge as markdown with YAML frontmatter, including its provenance, trust, and freshness conventions.
Experience with W3C semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and industrial information models such as ISA-95 or the Asset Administration Shell.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with graph query languages (Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL).
Experience with LLM-based information extraction, entity resolution, and evaluation of retrieval quality.
Experience with data catalogs and metadata platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, DataHub).
3+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones.
Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies.

What We Offer

Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
401k
Paid Time off
Parental and Caregiver Leave
Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life
To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

Job Description

Cooperative Institute for Climate, Ocean, & Ecosystem Studies (CICOES) has an outstanding opportunity for a Research Scientist IV to join the Ocean Molecular Ecology team.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the lead Research Scientist/Engineer 4, the Research Scientist IV will contribute to research conducted in collaboration between the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) – Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory (PMEL) and the University of Washington (UW) – Cooperative Institute for Climate, Ocean, and Ecosystem Studies (CICOES) on climate change impacts on marine mammals, fish, zooplankton, phytoplankton, and microbial ecology. The ideal candidate will have strong molecular ecology experience with a working knowledge of bioinformatics and software development as well as a deep understanding of marine pelagic and benthic ecologies and impacts of climate change and ocean acidification. The position requires independent planning, prioritizing, and execution of projects and tasks under the general direction of the project PI.

The position is at a federal facility that requires U.S. citizenship or permanent residency. A federal background check will be required. This role is primarily based at the NOAA PMEL facilities in Seattle, Washington. Work hours are flexible, but should be between 8 am to 6:30 pm at 100% FTE. Lead molecular work and bioinformatic analysis on OME-related environmental samples. (30%)

added.title: Research Scientist
added.description:
Job Description

RESEARCH SCIENTIST (OPEN RANK)

The Nemours Center for Healthcare Delivery Science (CHDS) is seeking a Research Scientist (Open Rank) in Florida, based in either Jacksonville or Orlando. Healthcare delivery science applies scientific methods to understand and improve the delivery, safety, outcomes, cost, quality, and value of pediatric health care. At CHDS, this broad mission spans the patient, family, community, clinical, and health-system levels and includes behavioral and psychosocial research, intervention development and implementation, digital health, and other research addressing pediatric health and health care.

Who We’re Looking For:
We seek an independent or emerging independent investigator from any disciplinary background whose research aligns with the Center’s mission. The position supports clinical and applied research, including healthcare delivery, behavioral, implementation, health services, and related research, but does not support laboratory-based basic or preclinical research. Candidates should demonstrate a clearly defined research focus and trajectory, with a vision for developing or sustaining an independent research program addressing important and innovative questions in pediatric health or health care. Successful candidates will complement and expand the Center’s existing research portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities

Advance a productive, independent program of research.
Pursue and maintain federal or national foundation funding.
Cultivate collaborations across Nemours that leverage its clinical populations, technological infrastructure, electronic health record and data resources, and multidisciplinary expertise.
Mentor trainees and junior investigators
Translate research findings to improve pediatric health and health care.
Contribute to Nemours’ educational mission.

CHDS-FL will serve as the research scientist’s primary appointment; faculty may also pursue academic appointments with the University of Central Florida College of Medicine in Orlando or Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science in Jacksonville.

Qualifications
: Candidates must hold an MD, MD/PhD, PhD, or other doctoral degree in a health-related discipline and demonstrate a strong record of research productivity appropriate to career stage. Candidates must have a clearly defined independent or emerging independent research program and demonstrated readiness to compete for federal or national foundation funding. Successful candidates will be expected to initiate grant submissions early in their appointment and establish or maintain external funding within three years. Rank will be commensurate with experience and accomplishments. Qualified applicants at varying career stages are encouraged to apply. Candidates may dedicate a portion of the position to clinical service in their professional specialty, if applicable.

Application process
: Apply through the Nemours Careers portal and submit a CV, cover letter, and 2-page research statement describing your current research program, planned grant submissions during the first 1-2 years at Nemours, and your longer-term strategy for developing or sustaining an externally funded research program. We will review applications as they are received.

Nemours is an Equal Opportunity Employer and committed to focusing on the best-qualified applicants for our openings.

Learn More

Center for Pediatric Healthcare Delivery Science

About Us

Nemours Children's Health is an internationally recognized pediatric health system serving more than 1.7 million patient encounters each year. We deliver care across six states through two freestanding children’s hospitals — Nemours Children's Hospital, Delaware and Nemours Children's Hospital, Florida — along with a network of more than 80 primary, urgent, and specialty care practices and more than 40 hospital partnerships.

Backed by the Nemours Foundation and Alfred I. duPont Trust, our $1.7B nonprofit system is dedicated to improving children's health through clinical care, research, education, advocacy, and prevention. Our Whole Child Health approach focuses equally on prevention and treatment, partnering with communities to help every child thrive.

Inclusion and belonging guide our strategy and growth. We are committed to culturally relevant care, reducing health disparities, and fostering an environment where every associate, patient, and family feels supported and valued.

Learn more at Nemours.org .

Proficiency with Software Development Life Cycle, CI/CD practices, application resiliency, and secure software delivery.
In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and related IT systems.

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related field, plus 3+ years of applied data science experience.
Experience with TCP/IP networking, cybersecurity technologies, and security-related telemetry.
Experience monitoring models in production and identifying data quality, drift, or performance issues.

, you will oversee the health, performance, and scalability of the organization's end-to-end data ecosystem, ensuring seamless operation across all layers of the data architecture. This role is responsible for monitoring the overall architecture, data quality, and data pipelines from the Silver layer through semantic models and reporting layers, proactively identifying and resolving data breaks and performance issues within an AWS environment. You will collaborate with engineering and business teams to design, build, and optimize enterprise data solutions, providing architectural guidance throughout the full development lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience supporting end-to-end data platform implementations, strong knowledge of cloud-based architecture and AWS services, experience working in Agile environments utilizing Jira, and relevant AWS certifications. This position requires a strategic thinker who can balance architectural best practices with operational excellence to deliver reliable, high-performing data solutions that support business objectives.

This is a remote opportunity, Monday-Friday 8AM-5PM ARIZONA MST. This can be a remote position if you live in the following state(s) only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NY, NM, NV, OH, OK, OR PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV, WY.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

Position Summary

This position supports Banner Health’s mission by assisting in the design, documentation, and implementation of technology solutions that meet business needs while adhering to organizational standards, security requirements, and healthcare compliance mandates. This role works under the guidance of senior architects to design cloud, AI-enabled, and on-premises solutions that enhance clinical care, operational efficiency, and patient engagement.

Core Functions

Collaborate with architects, project teams, and stakeholders to document current-state and future-state architectures at varying levels (Conceptual, Logical, Physical).
Assist in evaluating vendor solutions for adherence with Banner Health’s architectural and cybersecurity standards.
Participate in the design of AI-powered healthcare applications (e.g. predictive analytics, NLP-driven clinical documentation, triage chatbots, business operations automation, etc.) with AWS, Azure, or other Cloud Service Providers as needed.
Support integration projects involving healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) to enable interoperability between clinical systems, data systems, and analytics platforms.
Help develop and mature architectural artifacts such as archetypes, reference architectures, and policy updates.
Work with stakeholders and appropriate teams to ensure solutions meet standards such as HIPAA, HITECH, and PCI DSS.
Participate in cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
Analyze business and IT environments to detect critical deficiencies and/or redundancies and recommend solutions for improvement.
Develop and maintain functional technology standards for enterprise consumption. Create solution patterns in focused technology domains. Serve as a credible expert advisor to peers and leadership on the appropriateness of current and future technologies based on value to the business.

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers of Banner Health with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.

NOTE: The core functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.

None

Type Of Supervisory Responsibilities

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

OE - Typical Office Environment: (Accountant, Administrative Assistant, Consultant, Program Manager)

Requires extensive sitting with periodic standing and walking.

May be required to lift up to 20 pounds.

Requires significant use of personal computer, phone and general office equipment.

Needs ability to communicate effectively through reading, writing, and speaking in person or on telephone.

May require off-site travel.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. Must have 5+ years of experience in development, infrastructure, or systems analysis, 3+ years of engineering or architecture experience and 2+ years of experience developing or delivering solutions for cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.

Must obtain AWS or Azure Architect certification and Security+ certification within one year of hire.

Must have a basic understanding of healthcare compliance and security frameworks. Knowledge of data integration concepts and APIs is required.

7+ years of experience in development, infrastructure, or systems analysis

About The Department

At Novo Nordisk, we want to make a difference. For more than 100 years, we have led the way in diabetes care. Being part of Novo Nordisk allows our employees to embark on the opportunity to help improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world.

In NC, we operate three pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are responsible for fulfilling different steps in our injectable and oral treatment supply chains. Our Product Supply Aseptic Manufacturing (PS AM) facility in Clayton, NC is a 457,000 square foot aseptic "fill and finish" site that is responsible for producing innovative, injectable diabetes and obesity treatments. At PS AM, you’ll join a global network of manufacturing professionals who are passionate about what they do.

What We Offer You

Leading pay and annual performance bonus for all positions

All employees enjoy generous paid time off including 14 paid holidays

Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance – effective day one

Guaranteed 8% 401K contribution plus individual company match option

Family Focused Benefits including 14 weeks paid parental & 6 weeks paid family medical leave

Free access to Novo Nordisk-marketed pharmaceutical products

Tuition Assistance

Life & Disability Insurance

Employee Referral Awards

At Novo Nordisk, you will find opportunities, resources, and mentorship to help grow and build your career. Are you ready to realize your potential? Join Team Novo Nordisk and help us make what matters.

The Position

Lead the delivery of practical AI solutions and sustained workforce adoption across DPM US Clayton. Translate approved site priorities into solution requirements, coordinate complex initiatives across functions and guide implementation with the AI Enablement Partner and site stakeholders. Combine hands-on delivery, process understanding and sound AI judgment to achieve measurable business outcomes, with direction from the site AI roadmap and the AI Enablement Specialist.

Reports to Senior Manager, Associate Director, or Director.

Essential Functions

Lead AI solution delivery, workforce adoption and business process automation across site functions

Translate approved site AI priorities into clear use cases and delivery plans with process owners

Align with Solution Architects, Enterprise AI, IT and Quality to follow technology and governance guidelines

Lead implementation of approved AI technologies for assigned initiatives

Translate business needs into solution requirements and guide hands-on delivery with the AI Enablement Partner

Drive workforce AI adoption through practical demonstrations, training and coaching

Assess data readiness, AI performance and human oversight before implementing and scaling solutions

Facilitate continuous improvement through reuse of approved enterprise AI and data capabilities

Contribute delivery experience and reusable solutions to relevant Novo Nordisk AI working groups

Coordinate initiative priorities, timelines, dependencies and risks; escalate decisions as needed

Measure AI adoption, productivity improvements and business outcomes

Follow all quality, safety, environmental and information security requirements in the performance of duties

Other Accountabilities, As Assigned

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in an open office environment with the possibility of frequent distraction. Ability to travel up to 10% of the time (% can change on a case-by-case basis based on the role).

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Operations Management, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems or related technical field of study from an accredited university required

Master’s degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Operations Management, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems or related technical field of study from an accredited university preferred

Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, software development, automation, or digital transformation required, preferably in a regulated industry

Practical experience building and implementing AI solutions that address business needs required

Proven track record of independently leading complex data, analytics, AI, or automation initiatives with measurable business improvements required

Working knowledge of data preparation, data modelling, relational databases and data integration required

Understanding of generative AI, model limitations, data quality and responsible use of AI required

Experience building solutions using SQL, Python, APIs, low-code tools, or similar development technologies required

Experience with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for data analysis, semantic modelling and reporting preferred

Experience with Databricks for data processing, analytics, or AI solutions preferred

Familiarity using Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) preferred

Practical experience using OpenAI products, including ChatGPT and Anthropic products, including Claude, for business workflows, AI adoption, or automation preferred

Ability to translate business needs into solution requirements and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders required

Ability to coordinate delivery and maintain effective stakeholder relationships across functions in a complex, matrixed and sometimes ambiguous environment required

Experience driving continuous improvement, AI adoption, or workforce capability development required

Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP and Novo Nordisk Quality Management System (QMS) requirements preferred

Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, adaptability and a practical approach to learning new tools and solving problems required

Ability to organize complex delivery activities, guide colleagues and follow through on agreed outcomes required

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

The Associate Engineer - AI and Agentics is responsible for building foundational AI-enabled applications, prototypes, prompts, tests, documentation, and agentic automations while learning SDLC best practices, security expectations, and responsible AI standards.

Assist in building simple AI-enabled prototypes, internal tools, and workflow automations.
Translate clearly defined requirements into small software components, scripts, prompts, test cases, and configuration changes.
Support prompt engineering, basic agent workflows, retrieval-assisted use cases, and API integrations.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools, such as coding copilots or agentic coding tools, to learn, prototype, document, and improve code with appropriate review.
Write and execute basic unit tests, validation checks, and troubleshooting steps to confirm expected behavior.
Maintain clear documentation, including setup notes, design summaries, prompt/spec notes, user instructions, and operational runbooks.
Participate in code reviews, demos, testing sessions, backlog discussions, and team learning activities.

Required
